01

Information Collection & Usage

When you share information with me—whether it's through contact forms, emails, or during a freelance/job assignment—you can be assured that your data is used solely for completing the services you've requested. I may collect basic personal information such as your name, email address, and files relevant to the project.

02

Data Retention & Deletion

Data is stored for a period of up to 30 days post-delivery. After this timeframe, all project-related information is permanently erased from my systems. I do not offer data recovery or post-deletion file access.

03

Confidentiality & NDA

All shared content is treated with the highest level of confidentiality. I am open to signing a Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) before project commencement to ensure legal security for your proprietary code and brand materials.

04

Project Agreements

Without a signed contract, all engagements are governed by mutual understanding. All services rendered are non-refundable once the work has been initiated or completed.

05

Legal Compliance

Adhering to Indian IT Act, 2000 and major US federal privacy guidelines including CCPA and FTC Act. I follow global best practices in data minimization and usage limitation.
